findings.note: Covers picks the Bruins moneyline (Novig probability 60%, and a related Covers page recommends it up to 65%), citing Boston's 9-4 home record, strong home 5-on-5 Corsi/xG, and a Jets 5-on-5 shooting run of 15.1% that it expects to cool off.

ESPN's injury report lists Winnipeg missing D Dylan DeMelo, D Elias Salomonsson, C Vladislav Namestnikov, RW Isak Rosen and C Nick Bjugstad, while Boston's only listed absence is C James Hagens (back, non-contact jersey per a separate Rotowire note).

Against Boston, the Jets are 6-4-0 in their last 10, the Bruins are 5-5-0, and Boston won the Oct. 2 meeting only 4-3 in OT; for context, Winnipeg's goalies are weak (Skinner .883, Daws .892) and its PK ranks 25th.
